title: CRITICAL: Teaching Adoption Audit Blocks All Other Teachings
summary: Teaching adoption audit (skill-wai-teaching-adoption-audit-v1.md.teaching) is foundational infrastructure. If spokes cannot verify teaching adoption, the entire framework breaks silently. This directive enforces blocking: no other teachings are offered/processed until audit is verified.

directive.rule: If skill-wai-teaching-adoption-audit-v1.md.teaching is not verified as adopted on a spoke, ALL other teaching processing is BLOCKED.
directive.enforcement: Wakeup Step 5 (teaching discovery) must check: has audit teaching been verified? If NO: surface CRITICAL warning and do NOT offer other teachings.
directive.blocking_trigger: IF adopted teaching status for audit teaching is false OR unverified → block all teaching processing
directive.unblock_path: User (or Ozi with approval) must run the audit, confirm results, mark as verified before other teachings are processed
directive.not_optional: This is non-negotiable framework infrastructure. Without it, spokes cannot reliably adopt teachings.

implementation_checklist: ☐ Batch Sequence updated: 'Required before: ALL other teachings'
☐ Blocking rule added: blocks wakeup Step 5 if not verified
☐ Wakeup Step 5 modified to check audit verification status
☐ If unverified: surface '⚠️ CRITICAL: Teaching adoption audit required'
☐ WAI-State.json extended with `_teaching_audit_verified: boolean` flag per spoke
enforcement_points: Wakeup Step 5: Check `_teaching_audit_verified` flag. If false/missing → BLOCK other teaching discovery
Teaching discovery: Do NOT present other teachings until audit verified
Closeout: Mark teaching adoption audit as 'verified' only after audit completes successfully
testing: Deploy to one spoke first. Verify: (1) audit teaching auto-adopted, (2) other teachings blocked until audit passed, (3) after audit, other teachings offered normally
rationale: If a spoke cannot verify teaching adoption, it should assume it's broken and not accept framework updates. Better to be loud about needing repair than silent about being broken.
scope_verified_by: user insight: 'if this doesnt work...we are building a broken wheel'
